{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Average masked-item cross-entropy within each sampled sequence, then average across sequences so histories with more masked targets do not dominate. Apply consistently to all four category models without label smoothing or final-position weighting; preserve sampling, architecture, inference and training settings.","edits":[{"find":"    return torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction="mean")","replace":"    position_losses = torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits, targets, reduction="none")
    sequence_indices = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
    sequence_loss_sums = position_losses.new_zeros(seq.size(0)).scatter_add(
        0, sequence_indices, position_losses
    )
    target_counts = mask.sum(dim=1).to(position_losses.dtype).clamp_min(1)
    return (sequence_loss_sums / target_counts).mean()"}]}],"change_summary":"Use equal sequence weighting for full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. Checkpoint shapes and predictor remain compatible."}
